Junior Project Manager – Intern
description:
### **Position**

We are looking for a **Junior Project Manager** to join our **Customer Service Department** .


This role will support the management and execution of cross\-functional projects and initiatives aimed at enhancing customer service processes, tools, and overall customer experience. Working closely with multiple business functions, the successful candidate will contribute to the implementation of innovative solutions, process improvements, and digital transformation initiatives, including Artificial Intelligence\-based technologies, to drive operational excellence and service quality.


### **Job responsibilities**

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES**

The role will involve the following responsibilities:


* Support the collection, analysis, and formalization of project requirements.
* Manage and maintain project plans and Gantt charts, defining activities, milestones, and timelines, ensuring the proper progress of initiatives, gathering feedback throughout the different project phases, and supporting project status tracking.
* Coordinate cross\-functional activities, ensuring alignment among stakeholders and the achievement of project objectives.
* Support the preparation and execution of functional and stress tests prior to go\-live and, following implementation, identify potential issues, corrective actions, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Support After\-Sales process improvement initiatives by monitoring service performance, collecting stakeholder feedback, and contributing to the identification of optimization opportunities.
* Analyze and monitor KPIs and the performance of newly implemented functionalities, processes, and initiatives, preparing reports and dashboards to support performance tracking and identify further development opportunities.
* Contribute to the evaluation and adoption of innovative digital solutions, including Artificial Intelligence\-based technologies, to enhance operational efficiency, streamline processes, and improve service quality.
* Contribute to the definition and implementation of action plans aimed at increasing operational efficiency, improving service quality, and enhancing customer satisfaction.
### **Profile**

**PROFILE**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Management Engineering, Economics, Information Technology, or related fields.
* Excellent analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Strong organizational and project coordination capabilities.
* knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Fluent English is required.
### **Additional information**

Located in Longarone.


Accordingly to internal internship regulation, for this position the month base salary is 800€.


Thank you in advance for your interest in this opening. Thélios is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, sex, gender (including gender identity and expression), pregnancy, age, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, familial status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status under applicable federal, state or local laws. At this time, only qualified candidates will be contacted.


***THÉLIOS***
**MAISON**
------------------------

At Thélios, visionary creativity and excellence collide to shape an unparalleled luxury eyewear experience.
  

Standing for LVMH excellence in eyewear, Thélios masters each step of the value chain, from the conception to distribution for some of the Group’s most prestigious Maisons.
  

Thélios has established its center of expertise at the foot of the Dolomites, in the Veneto region, the sanctuary of Italian eyewear.

title: SAP SD Consultant (m/f/d)
description:
SAP SD Consultant (m/f/d)


**Employer**  

SteelcoBelimed  

  

**Location**  

Padua/Riese Pio X, Italy
  

or
  

Grosuplje, Slovenia  

  

**Department**  

IT \& Business Applications  

  

**Type of work**  

Full\-time  

  

**Type of contract**  

Unlimited


Steelco and Belimed have joined forces to lead the way in advanced cleaning and sterile workflow solutions. This partnership is powered by our united strengths: a dynamic product range, relentless innovation, utmost reliability, and an unmatched commitment to customer satisfaction. As SteelcoBelimed, we “Innovate with confidence”, as we set new industry standards to meet our customer’s needs offering high\-quality products and comprehensive services for Infection Control and Life Science.  

  

We are seeking a motivated **SAP SD Consultant** (m/f/d) to join our Business Applications team.  

  

*Please note*: depending on the location of the candidate, we are open to filling this position on our locations in Italy (**Riese Pio X** or **Padua**) or Slovenia (**Grosuplje**).  




**Your tasks \& responsibilities**


  

In this role, you will support the design, implementation, rollout, and optimization of SAP Sales and Distribution processes within SAP S/4HANA and integrated application landscapes. You will work closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, external partners, and international project teams to translate business requirements into effective SAP SD solutions and contribute to successful transformation initiatives.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyze, design, configure, and support SAP SD processes in SAP S/4HANA, including sales order management, pricing, delivery, billing, returns, and credit/debit processes.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, process designs, and SAP SD configuration concepts.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, IT teams, external vendors, and system integrators to deliver end\-to\-end SAP SD solutions.
* Support SAP S/4HANA implementation, migration, rollout, and optimization activities with a focus on Sales \& Distribution.
* Coordinate and execute unit, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing for SAP SD processes and interfaces.
* Prepare documentation, training materials, process descriptions, and solution handover documents.
* Support organizational change management, user adoption, and key\-user enablement related to SAP SD solutions.
* Analyze and resolve incidents, defects, and process issues in cooperation with business users and technical teams.
* Ensure compliance with company governance, SAP standards, security policies, and regulatory requirements.
  

**Your Profile**


  

**Education \& Experience*** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* Approximately 5 years of professional experience as an SAP SD Consultant or in a comparable SAP functional consulting role.
* Solid hands\-on experience with SAP SD configuration and end\-to\-end sales processes, ideally in SAP S/4HANA environments.
* SAP SD certification, SAP S/4HANA certification, or SAP Activate knowledge is an advantage.
* SAP S/4HANA project experience, especially in sales, distribution, logistics, or order\-to\-cash processes.
* Experience in SAP implementation, rollout, migration, support, or process optimization projects.
* Good understanding of integration points with other SAP modules such as MM, FI/CO, LE, PP, and CRM or related applications.
* Experience in manufacturing, industrial, medical products, or international sales and service environments are a plus.
* Experience working in international and cross\-functional environments.


**Skills \& Competencies*** Strong functional knowledge of SAP SD processes, customizing, master data, pricing, output management, and document flows.
* Good understanding of SAP S/4HANA capabilities and integration with surrounding SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into practical SAP solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, including structured incident and defect resolution.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with business users and technical teams.
* Collaborative team player with a proactive, service\-oriented, and results\-focused mindset.
* Fluent English is required; Italian language skills are optional. German language skills are a plus.

**Our Offer**


* Work in an international, fast\-growing industry that makes a real impact on healthcare and pharmaceutical industry.
* Shape the future of a global business through SAP S/4HANA transformations, international rollouts, and digitalization initiatives across multiple countries and business functions.
* A chance to make a real business impact, influencing how core business functions operate every day.
* An international and collaborative environment, working closely with business leaders, key users, external partners, and colleagues across different countries and cultures.
* Exposure to modern technologies and transformation programs, including SAP S/4HANA, Digital Manufacturing, EWM, CPQ, Salesforce integrations, and other enterprise platforms.
* A culture of ownership, transparency, and open communication, where ideas are welcomed, initiative is encouraged, and people are empowered to drive change.
* Continuous professional growth, with opportunities to expand beyond traditional SAP consulting into business transformation, enterprise architecture, process harmonization, and project leadership.

**Ready to make an impact?**  

**Apply now and join our team!**
Apply online


  

The personal data contained in your resume will be processed by Steelco S.p.A., with registered office in Riese Pio X – TV, Via Balegante 27 (“Company”), for the selection process relating to this position or other similar positions. Detailed information, including information on the rights recognized by the legislation on the protection of personal data, can be found in the information notice available on the Company's website on the “Careers” page (https://www.steelcogroup.com/it/careers/).
